intent: Pause under cabin roofs, read falling-ice warnings, then cross the open snow. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

sections.name: The first white shelter
sections.lesson: The amber mark warns where ice will fall. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

signs.text:
The first white shelter
Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

sections.name: The cabin terraces
sections.lesson: Jump the snow-covered cabin walls. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

signs.text:
The cabin terraces
Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

sections.name: The exposed snow road
sections.lesson: Leave the roof after the ice passes. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

signs.text:
The exposed snow road
Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

sections.name: Above the snowline
sections.lesson: Climb the cabin roofs above the drifting snow. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

signs.text:
Above the snowline
Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

sections.name: Between the fir shelters
sections.lesson: Cross one exposed opening at a time. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

signs.text:
Between the fir shelters
Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

sections.name: The first frozen stream
sections.lesson: Brake on stone before the final frozen cuts. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.
